site.context: Corpus Christi Bay SWRO design-basis reject (PCCA industrial seawater desalination average Outfall 001 at 50% recovery); not a measured process-brine sample, not Texas Gulf seawater feed, not a concession

meta.quality: Majors cited from PCCA Design Basis Table 2 average Outfall 001 effluent (Na, Ca, Mg, K, Cl, SO4) based on Corpus Christi Bay sample data × 50% recovery. HCO3 230 mg/L omitted (not in SUBSTANCES). Ba/Sr/B/SiO2/NO3/F omitted (trace vs majors). Not a measured Harbor Island reject sample.
meta.notes: Ion masses converted from tabulated mg/L to g/kg with density 1.051 kg/L (screening from ~66 g/L TDS band — not a CTD). mol_per_kg = g_per_kg / molarMassG from engine/model SUBSTANCES. Literature numbers are preferred over forcing charge balance. salinity_g_per_kg is the summed cited majors, not the 66,000 mg/L TDS headline. Design-basis desal-reject is not a mineral concession and is not Great Salt Lake or Salton Sea chemistry.
